leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a class structure for an LRU Cache with capacity management.
Initialize a doubly linked list and a hash map to track cache entries.
Implement methods to add new key-value pairs while enforcing capacity limits.
Manipulate the linked list to move accessed items to the most recent position.
Apply the LRU eviction policy to remove the least recently used entry when capacity is exceeded.
Integrate get and put operations to maintain cache consistency and performance.
Configure the cache to handle edge cases like updating existing keys.
